_meta.description: Hand-curated pharma pipeline seed used by backend/services/pharma_pipeline_service.py to compute per-asset rNPV. Indian listed pharma names carry substantial in-flight pipelines (NCEs, biosimilars, complex generics) whose value the standard FCF-based DCF cannot capture. This is a Phase A seed — three tickers (SUNPHARMA, DRREDDY, BIOCON) with 2-3 illustrative assets each, plausible but invented numbers. A production data ingestion (operator-curated form, sell-side scrape, or analyst-day notes) is out of scope for Phase A.

field_dictionary.name: Human-readable asset / programme name. Surfaces in driver lists.
field_dictionary.phase: One of discovery | preclinical | phase_1 | phase_2 | phase_3 | filed | approved | marketed. Phase determines the default probability of approval (POA) via POA_BY_PHASE in the service. Override with custom_poa_override when CMC / regulatory has a known special situation.
field_dictionary.indication: Therapy area or specific disease label. Cosmetic only — the math is indifferent to indication.
field_dictionary.target_market_size_usd: TAM in USD, peak-year. The driver of peak revenue together with expected_peak_share_pct.
field_dictionary.expected_peak_share_pct: Peak market share assumed, 0-100. Sanity-warned if >60%.
field_dictionary.expected_margin_pct: Operating margin on peak sales, 0-100. Captures the profitability of the franchise once exclusivity is in effect.
field_dictionary.expected_launch_year_offset: Years from today until first revenue. Cashflows are pushed out this many years before the penetration ramp begins.
field_dictionary.exclusivity_years: How many years post-launch the asset enjoys protection (patent / data / market exclusivity). NCE typical 10-12; biosimilar typical 5-7.
field_dictionary.is_biosimilar: When true: faster penetration ramp (rebate-driven formulary adoption) and shorter default exclusivity. The service applies a different curve.
field_dictionary.custom_poa_override: Optional explicit POA (0-1). Use when CMC issues, breakthrough designation, accelerated approval, or a known FDA / CDSCO holdup makes the phase-default wrong.

caveats: All numbers are invented for Phase A. Do NOT cite these to anyone — they are scaffolding, not data.
Production data needs an ingestion pipeline (operator form + sell-side / analyst-day cross-check). Out of scope for Phase A.
Tickers are NSE bare symbols, no .NS / .BO suffix. Match the convention used by backend/data/holdco_underlyings.json.
